''The first casualty of war is innocence.''
White tie, commonly seen as part of ancient sailor uniforms. Use of child soldiers is as old as warfare itself. Kids are easy to control, and they accept any narrative if it comes from place of authority. And though often pitied, they die all the same.
Same as it ever was.

^orange;Crouching while TAKING FIRE grants +60% BALLISTIC RES and +20% DODGE, but -15% Weapon Proficiency for up to 5s | 10s cooldown.^reset;
ko:
''전쟁에서 가장 먼저 죽는 건 순수다.''
하얀 넥타이로, 옛날 수병 제복의 일부로 흔히 보이는 것이다. 소년병의 역사는 전쟁의 역사와 함께한다. 아이들은 다루기 쉽고, 권위가 있는 곳에서 오는 이야기라면 무엇이든 받아들인다. 그리고 종종 동정의 대상이 되지만, 그래도 똑같이 죽어간다.
늘 그렇듯이.

en: Seifuku White Tie

White, 15-by-100cm cloth belt with 1000 stitches, each made by individual woman. Believed to confer courage, strength and immunity from injury. Entire organisations were created with the sole purpose of sewing knots on a piece of cloth and sending it to soldiers overseas. As any other Shinto amulet, it would normally be useless as a protection gear, but what you've been through can hardly be called ''normal''.
^orange;Gain a ^#C8FAFA;HIT-SHIELD^orange; layer that absorbs one hit | 45s cooldown | Stacks with other ^#C8FAFA;HIT-SHIELDS.^reset;
ko:
가로 15cm, 세로 100cm의 흰 천 띠에 서로 다른 여성이 한 땀씩 바느질한 1,000개의 바늘자국. 용기와 힘, 부상 면역을 준다고 믿어졌다. 천에 매듭을 지어 해외의 병사에게 보내는 것만을 목적으로 세워진 조직들도 있었다. 다른 신토 부적과 마찬가지로 보통은 방어구로서 아무 소용이 없겠지만, 당신이 겪어온 일을 '보통'이라 부르긴 어렵겠지.
^orange;한 번의 피격을 흡수하는 ^#C8FAFA;HIT-SHIELD^orange; 하나 획득 | 재사용 대기시간 45초 | 다른 ^#C8FAFA;HIT-SHIELD와 중첩됨.^reset;

en: Senninbari
Senninbari of the Selfless

White lily represents purity. Japan often put women in danger of combat, as evidenced by Himeyuri Corps and Volunteer Fighting Corps - late-war auxiliary units that would include young student girls and unmarried women of 17 to 40 years. Female chastity was so important in Asian societies that women would rather die than risk capture by ''gaijins''.

^green;+1.5% HP Regeneration per second.
ko:
흰 백합은 순결을 상징한다. 일본은 여성을 전투의 위험에 자주 내몰았다 — 히메유리 부대와 의용전투대가 그 증거이며, 종전기의 이 보조 부대에는 어린 여학생과 17세에서 40세의 미혼 여성들이 들어갔다. 여성의 정숙은 아시아 사회에서 그토록 중요해서, 여자들은 '외국인'에게 붙잡힐 위험을 감수하느니 차라리 죽음을 택했다.
 
^green;초당 체력 재생 +1.5%.

en: White Lily Flower

''When you go to war as a boy, you have a great illusion of immortality. Other people get killed, not you... Then, when you are badly wounded the first time, you lose that illusion, and you know it can happen to you.''
Gilt badge awarded to military personnel for a wound sustained in combat. Hardly a Medal of Valor, but it's sure easy to earn.

^#96CBE7;Counts as a [CHEST] part of Medic Set.^reset; | ^#F2B8EC;[FULL SET 3x REQUIRED] - Passively heal 15HP for self and nearby players every 4s.
ko:
''소년이 전쟁에 나가면, 죽지 않는다는 커다란 환상을 품게 되지. 다른 사람이 죽지, 나는 아니라고... 그러다 처음으로 크게 다치면 그 환상을 잃고, 내가 죽을 수 있다는 걸 알게 된다.''
전투에서 입은 부상으로 군인에게 수여되는 금도금 배지. 용맹 훈장은 아니지만, 얻기는 정말 쉽지.
 
^#96CBE7;의무병 세트의 [CHEST] 부품으로 취급.^reset; | ^#F2B8EC;[풀 세트 3개 필요] - 4초마다 자신과 주변 플레이어의 체력을 15 회복.

en: Wounded Soldier Badge
''Dare-to-Die Corps'' Grenade Bag

National flag of Japan, with writings all around the red circle. Known in Japan as ''Yosegaki Hinomaru'', it was traditionally presented to a man prior to his induction into the Japanese armed forces or before his deployment. It was signed by the relatives, neighbors, friends, and co-workers of the future soldier with good luck messages, exhortations, or other personal messages.

^orange;+20% DODGE Chance.^reset;
ko:
일본 국기. 붉은 원 주변으로 글씨가 빼곡하다. 일본에서는 '요세가키 히노마루'라 부르며, 전통적으로 입대를 앞둔 남자나 파병을 앞둔 이에게 전해주던 것이다. 예비 병사의 친척, 이웃, 친구, 동료들이 행운을 비는 글이나 격려, 혹은 사적인 메시지를 적어 넣었다.
 
^orange;회피 확률 +20%.^reset;

en: Good Luck Flag

Insignia of the Japanese Navy's SNLF paratroopers, depicting an anchor and two crossed parachutes. Paras were planned to be used for strategic tasks like airfield and coastal defences capture, inland diversion, recon and others, timed in support of IJN's amphibious assaults. Since the late 1942, as Japan lost the initiative and was in no position to launch air/amphibious assaults, paratroopers were used exclusively as an elite light infantry force, much like the German Fallschirmjägers.
^#96CBE7;+10% Movement Speed and +5% DODGE when holding a LIGHT weapon.^reset;
ko:
닻과 교차한 두 개의 낙하산을 새긴 일본 해군 SNLF 낙하산병 휘장. 낙하산병은 비행장과 해안 방어진지 탈취, 내륙 교란, 정찰 같은 전략적 임무에 투입될 계획이었고, 해군의 상륙 작전과 호흡을 맞춰 운용될 예정이었다. 1942년 후반 이후 일본이 주도권을 잃고 공중·상륙 작전을 벌일 처지가 못 되면서, 낙하산병은 독일 팔슈름예거처럼 정예 경보병으로만 쓰였다.
^#96CBE7;경무기를 들고 있을 때 이동 속도 +10%, 회피 +5%.^reset;

en: IJN Paratrooper Insignia

''Comfort Bags'' were care packages that families or patriotic women's organizations would pack for Japanese soldiers. These packages contained various items such as food, candies, cigarettes, letters of encouragement and daily necessities. As the war progressed, the contents became less luxurious and it became more and more difficult to deliver Imon-Bukuro. Little gifts like these make a huge difference for battle-weary soldiers who are removed from everyday comforts.
^green;+20% Max HP.^reset;
ko:
'위문 부대'는 가족이나 애국 부녀회가 일본군 병사를 위해 꾸려 보낸 선물 꾸러미였다. 꾸러미에는 음식, 사탕, 담배, 격려 편지, 생필품 등이 들어 있었다. 전황이 악화될수록 내용물은 초라해졌고, 이몬부쿠로를 전달하기도 점점 어려워졌다. 이런 작은 선물이 일상의 위안과 멀어진 전장의 병사에게는 큰 힘이 된다.
^green;최대 체력 +20%.^reset;

en: Imon-Bukuro

Among many items inside Imon-Bukuro, one of the most cherished ones were Imon Ningyo, or ''Comfort Dolls'' - little handmade plushies resembling Japanese women. These dolls played a unique role in a soldier's life, serving both as amulets and objects of affection - troops would give them names and dress them in pretty clothes, possibly reminding them of sisters and mothers back in Japan. 

^#96CBE7;+3HP/s when under 50% HP.^reset;
ko:
이몬부쿠로 안의 여러 물건 중 가장 사랑받은 것은 '이몬 인형', 즉 '위문 인형' — 일본 여성을 본뜬 손바느질 작은 봉제인형이었다. 이 인형들은 병사의 삶에서 독특한 역할을 했는데, 부적인 동시에 애정의 대상이 되어 병사들은 이름을 지어주고 예쁜 옷을 입혀주며, 그것으로 일본에 있는 누이와 어머니를 떠올렸다.
 
^#96CBE7;체력 50% 미만일 때 초당 체력 +3.^reset;

en: Letter from Sulfur Island

A set of white cloth stripes and luminous markers for night-time identification. Night combat took a large portion of training time in IJA bootcamps. In face of Allied firepower superiority, sudden and well-timed night incursions proved to be effective and demoralizing. Until they weren't.

en: Night Warfare Stripes

Since SMGs were scarce in Japanese Army and Navy, they were issued to specialist units like paratroopers, with exceptions being few and far between. It was very common for pre-WW2 world armies to dismiss SMGs, only to start desperately ramping up production once they realised their deadliness. 
  
^Orange;ALL IJA/SNLF RIFLEMEN SUMMONS are equipped with Kokura T100 SMGs which further improves their firepower at close range and are IMMUNE to Suppression.^reset;

일본 육군과 해군에서 기관단총은 귀했기 때문에 낙하산병 같은 전문 부대에 지급되었고, 예외는 극히 드물었다. 제2차 세계대전 이전 세계 각국군이 기관단총을 무시하다가 그 치명성을 깨닫고 필사적으로 생산을 늘리기 시작한 것은 아주 흔한 일이었다.

India became a testbed for post-war military theories and doctrines, and despite being an infinite money sink, the lessons learned by the IJA turned it into the most advanced military force of the late 20th century, forcing others to copy their equipment and their findings about modern warfare.

^Orange;모든 호헤이 '60 소총병 소환이 이와시타 T30 소총과 방파편 조끼를 장비해 화력과 소화기 저항이 향상되고 제압에 면역.^reset;

en: ^#EAC0CE;Persuasion Needles^reset;

Despite common perception, swords were rarely used by the NRA, usually only as an auxiliary melee, or last resort weapon. Easy to forge, swords were used by militia and police units who weren't expected to fight on the frontline, often didn't have firearms, and for whom swords and spears were enough to uphold order. Dadao also was a weapon of terror (and warcrimes), frequently used to decapitate captured bandits and traitors.

M35 helmet with a Kuomintang insignia. Hans von Seeckt, Chiang Kai-Shek's military advisor, proposed an ''80 Division Plan'' for reforming the entire Chinese army into 80 divisions of highly trained, well-equipped troops organised along German lines. The plan was never fully realised, and as the Second Sino-Japanese War kicked off, only about 20 divisions were somewhat ready. After years of fighting, all that German equipment and training disappeared.

Standard Chinese field cap with a Kuomintang insignia. National Revolutionary Army was initially a military arm of the Chinese Nationalist Party, or the Kuomintang. Existing from 1924 to 1947, NRA was a very large (at ~14 million men) and a very divided force, as at times it consisted of Chiang Kai-Shek's loyal troops, warlord armies, various militias and even Chinese Communist Party's armed forces (albeit only nominally).

Imperial Japanese Navy's green cotton field cap. Rivalry between IJN and IJA reached it's height in the 1930's. When Japan wanted to expand it's territories through conquest, Navy proposed ''Strike South'' strategy, where Japan would attack Western colonies, and Army proposed to capture Siberia in a ''Strike North'' plan. The resulting rivalry between the two parties led to a series of mutual assassinations in the government.

Rikusenfuku pants with putees and hobnailed boots. Despite their training, there were very few moments of glory for the SNLF. After disasterous Battle of Midway, Japan was no longer capable of launching any sorts of amphibious attacks, and SNLF was used only as a defensive force. They were eventually decimated by the advancing US Marines, island by island, unit by unit.

Maiden-Soldiers were equipped with custom-sewn white load-bearing equipment to keep up the ''theme'' of white-top, red-bottom uniforms. Since Gensokyo often defied logic and common sense, a ''go with the vibes'' approach, previously foreign to the rigid IJA, had to be adopted. Inside these pouches Maiden-Soldiers carried all sorts of ritualistic implements and/or snacks, both for morale purposes.

^#EAC0CE;+25 Max Ability Mana and increased Ability Mana Regen.^reset;

무녀병에게는 '흰 상의, 붉은 하의' 제복의 '콘셉트'를 지키려고 특별 재봉한 흰색 휴대 장비가 지급됐다. 환상향은 종종 논리와 상식을 무시했기에, 경직된 IJA에게는 낯설던 '그냥 바이브로 가는' 접근법을 받아들여야 했다. 이 주머니들에 무녀병은 온갖 의례용 도구와 간식을 사기를 위해 넣고 다녔다.

Due to their brutality, use of torture, and general warcrimes, they have a reputation in Asia very comparable to that of the SS in the West. 
^#96CBE7;Fear Factor [CHEST]: Nearby infantry become hesitant, reducing their effective firerate by 0.25s.^reset;
ko:
켐페이타이 휘장이 달린 98식 튜닉. IJA의 악명 높은 헌병대는 수많은 역할을 하는 조직이었다 — 방첩, 반군 진압, 인적 정보, 포로 수용소 경비, 고가치 목표 급습, 통행 허가, 식량 징발 등. 잔혹함과 고문 사용, 일반적인 전쟁범죄 때문에 아시아에서의 평판은 서구의 SS에 비견될 만하다.
^#96CBE7;공포 유발 [CHEST]: 주변 보병이 주저하여 유효 발사 간격 0.25초 증가.^reset;

en: Type 98 Tunic (Kempeitai)

Type 98 cotton tunic with officer gear. Commanding officers often have to risk their lives on the battlefield, much like the men under their command. You want to win the battle? Then get your boots on the ground and lead your men!

en: Type 98 Officer Tunic

Imperial Japanese Army officer's field cap. Japanese officers had to procure their uniforms themselves. Because of this, there was a great variety of uniforms that followed the same pattern but had different coloration, materials and overall quality, depending on how much money the officer was ready to spend.

일본 제국 육군 장교 야전모. 일본군 장교는 제복을 직접 구해야 했다. 덕분에 같은 패턴이면서도 장교가 쓸 돈에 따라 색, 재료, 품질이 다른 다양한 제복이 나왔다.

en: Type 98 Officer Field Cap

Type 98 pants with a (decorative) Shin-Gunto on the belt. More ''battle-hardened'' NCO's preferred to carry their swords on the back, because it turns out that you have to crawl a lot on modern battlefield. Officers, however, don't crawl.

허리에 (장식용) 신군도를 찬 98식 바지. 더 '전투 경험' 있는 부사관들은 검을 등에 멨다 — 현대 전장에서 기어야 하는 일이 많다는 게 밝혀졌으니까. 하지만 장교는 기지 않는다.

en: Type 98 Officer Pants

Tube rucksack issued to IJA light infantry units. Jungle warfare bears innumerable risks, with tropical diseases and predatory fauna being just a tip of the iceberg. Japanese forces in Burmese Theatre of Operations gained reputation of experts in jungle warfare, as they were willing enough to cut through the thickest, most impassible terrain. British Chindits soon challenged that reputation.

^#96CBE7;Feed Off The Land: Slightly reduces hunger rate.^reset;
ko:
IJA 경보병 부대에 지급된 튜브 배낭. 정글전은 무수한 위험을 안겨줬고 열대 질병과 육식 동물은 빙산의 일각이었다. 버마 전선의 일본군은 가장 울창하고 통행 불가능한 지형도 뚫고 지나갈 만큼 정글전 전문가로 평판을 얻었다. 영국군 친딧 부대가 곧 그 명성에 도전했다.
 
^#96CBE7;현지 조달: 배고픔 속도를 약간 감소.^reset;

en: IJA Tube Pack

Type 98 tropical shirt, with 2/3 sleeves. Empire of Japan was an underdeveloped island nation trying to win against several major world powers across several Theaters of War. Supply was vital in these circumstances, and IJA's supply in the Pacific and South-Eastern Asia was ridiculously awful.

^green;+10% Movement Speed.^reset;
ko:
소매가 3분의 2 길이인 98식 열대 셔츠. 일본 제국은 여러 전선에서 여러 강대국을 상대로 이기려는 저개발 섬나라였다. 이런 상황에서 보급은 생명줄이었는데, 태평양과 동남아의 IJA 보급은 말도 안 될 정도로 형편없었다.
 
^green;이동 속도 +10%.^reset;

en: Type 98 Tropical Shirt

Late-war modification of Sen-bou field cap. Fighting in tropical areas was dictated by supply, and Japanese were notorious in this regard, as soldiers often had to subsist on meager rations and foraged food. Two-thirds of total IJA death count was attributed to illness and starvation. 
  
^green;+10% Movement Speed.^reset;
ko:
종전기의 센보 야전모 개수형. 열대 전투는 보급에 좌우됐고, 일본군은 병사들이 쥐꼬리 배급과 채집 식량으로 연명해야 할 만큼 이 점에서 악명 높았다. IJA 총사망자의 3분의 2가 질병과 기아로 추정된다.
  
^green;이동 속도 +10%.^reset;

en: Type 98 Field Cap w/ Flaps
Type 98 Shorts

Type 98 tropical shirt with short sleeves. Hot and humid tropical islands of the Pacific were just as harsh on men as on their equipment. Cotton uniforms of the Japanese would literally rot away and come apart at the seams, at which point soldiers would take American clothes, likely from the dead G.I.s.

^green;+10% Movement Speed.^reset;
ko:
반소매 98식 열대 셔츠. 태평양의 덥고 습한 열대 섬은 장비만큼이나 사람에게도 가혹했다. 일본군의 면제복은 말 그대로 썩어서 솔기가 뜯어졌고, 그쯤 되면 병사들은 미군 옷을 가져다 입었다 — 아마 죽은 GI한테서.
 
^green;이동 속도 +10%.^reset;

en: Type 98 Tropical Shirt w/ Short Sleeves

NCO's Type 98 tropical shirt, with 2/3 sleeves. As in every other nation in the world, NCOs in Japan came from enlisted personnel, unlike proper officers. If your average soldier a was stubborn fanatic, you can guess who were the people that lead them into battles.

소매가 3분의 2 길이인 부사관용 98식 열대 셔츠. 세계 모든 군대와 마찬가지로 일본의 부사관도 정규 장교와 달리 병 출신이다. 평범한 병사가 고집 센 광신병자라면, 그들을 전투로 이끄는 자들은 어땠을지 짐작할 수 있다.

en: Type 98 Tropical NCO Shirt

''Death is now inevitable. As men of the Empire, it is now time to sacrifice ourselves and deal a blow to the Americans, creating with our very bones an impenetrable barrier in the Pacific. Shame not yourself in choosing life and be taken prisoner over death.'' 
  
^#C9C2B2;Pacific Bulwark [HEAD]: Summons one PACIFIC IJA RIFLEMAN when using a ^reset;^orange;DEPLOYMENT ORDER^reset; ^#C9C2B2;60s Cooldown. |^reset; ^#DBC5A6;DEF: +10% DODGE |^reset; ^#FFCE6D;Frontline Command [CHEST]: +10% One-Handed Proficiency | -20% projectile spread for One-Handed Weapons.^reset;

''이제 죽음은 피할 수 없다. 제국의 남자로서, 이제 우리 자신을 바쳐 미국인에게 타격을 주고, 우리 뼈로 태평양의 무적의 방벽을 세울 시간이다. 죽음 대신 삶을 택해 포로가 되는 수치를 스스로 짓지 마라.''

Type 98 pants with a sword scabbard. Swords in WW2 were more of a badge of honor than actual weapons, as infantry tactics favoured firepower over melee charges several decades prior. But if nothing else, it sure is a morale boost to see your leader charge the enemy head-first with a sword in hands.

검집이 달린 98식 바지. 제2차 세계대전의 검은 실전 무기라기보다 명예의 휘장에 가까웠고, 보병 전술이 근접 돌격보다 화력을 우선한 건 수십 년 전이다. 그래도 칼 든 지휘관이 적진을 향해 돌진하는 걸 보면 확실히 사기는 오른다.

''A word to you about escape. There is no barbed wire. No stockade. No watchtower. They are not necessary. We are an island in the jungle. Escape is impossible. You would die.''
